credit: FlyBody model by the FlyBody contributors, developed by Google DeepMind and HHMI Janelia Research Campus; Vaxenburg et al., Nature 643, 1312-1320 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09029-4.
pre_hackathon: Underlying FlyBody anatomical mesh and FruitFly XR FlyV2 derivative predate the hackathon. Only this web conversion and CausalFly integration were performed during the hackathon.
geometry: Existing runtime LOD triangles and 92-bone rig preserved, no additional anatomical vertices or decimation; glTF splits vertices at material/normal/UV seams.
method: Blender FBX import -> glTF PBR reconstruction with original 1024px atlases -> binary glTF export, no animation tracks, no compression decoder or CDN
appearance: Authored wild-type-inspired PBR Beauty Pass 5. Wing membrane is mostly transparent with a low-weight microfacet reflection layer; there is no diffuse white membrane or glass-refraction model. This remains an engineered presentation approximation, not measured Drosophila thin-film optical data. Source anatomical/material partitions and vein geometry are preserved.
web_wings: Double-sided neutral membrane, alpha 0.16; veins remain opaque source geometry. Compatible authored approximation, not measured optical data.
omitted_map: Unity MetallicSmoothness is redundant with the roughness atlas; metallic remains zero.
